probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Newport Homeowners Association Overview Announcements Documents Board Events About Buy Newport Newport Homeowners Association Overview Announcements Documents Board Events About Buy Newport Clubhouse Reservable clubhouse for meetings and small events with kitchen access. All amenities Contact us The clubhouse is available for resident events by reservation only. Reservation guidelines: Submit requests at least 7 days in advance through the management portal. A refundable security deposit may be required for private events. Maximum occupancy must be followed per posted signage. Events must conclude by community quiet hours. After each use, the host must clean, return furnishings to their original layout, and secure the building.
